q: Which former Danish prime minister became Secretary General of NATO in 2009?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 and November 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvilken tidligere dansk statsminister blev i 2009 generalsekretær for NATO?

learn.text: Poul Nyrup Rasmussen of the Social Democrats was prime minister from 1993 to 2001. Anders Fogh Rasmussen became NATO Secretary General in 2009.

da.q: Hvem var Danmarks første kvindelige statsminister?

learn.text: Two years later, in 2011, the Social Democrats regained power, and Helle Thorning-Schmidt became Denmark's first female prime minister, for the next four years until 2015, when Lars Løkke Rasmussen again became prime minister.

learn.text: He was succeeded as prime minister by his party colleague Lars Løkke Rasmussen of Venstre, who was prime minister from 2009 to 2011, and again from 2015 to 2019.

q: How has the unemployment benefit period for the unemployed developed since 1994?
